name: Grasping Dead
disable: DC 22 Religion check (trained) to ritually pray for the dead or DC 24 Occultism check (trained) to exorcise the spirits' anger; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates.
routine: (1 action) The grasping hands batter all creatures in the area, dealing 2d6+7 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save). On a critical failure, a creature is dragged partially into the earth, becoming Immobilized until it Escapes. If already immobilized, it's fully submerged and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

items.name: Shifting Earth
items.text:
Trigger At least two creatures enter the area

---

Effect The earth shifts wildly as the hands of the dead spring forth from the ground. The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures within the area are knocked Prone unless they succeed at a DC 26 Reflex save save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: Hands of the buried dead rise from the ground, grabbing and tearing at creatures in the area to drag them underground.
